title: Freedom Yield Metal — Evidence Manifest v1
description: Formal contract for /api/evidence.json. The runtime file is generated daily by scripts/gen-evidence.sh from /api/validator.json + static project config. This schema is the authoritative shape v1; breaking changes (removed required field, narrowed enum, changed type, restricted pattern) require a new major version published at /api/evidence.schema.v2.json. The v1 URL stays reachable for at least 18 months after v2 publication. Companion docs: docs/EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.md.

_comment.description: Human-readable note on how the file is generated; informational only.

$schema.description: Self-reference to this schema's URL. Optional; recommended for tooling that auto-discovers schemas.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. v1 stays at 1; bump to 2 requires a new schema file at a new URL.

network.description: Canonical network label; broader than the raw RPC name (which is just 'mainnet').

node_id.description: On-chain NodeID identifier on Metal Blockchain P-Chain.

validator_status.description: 'active' iff the underlying validator.json's observedAt is within the freshness threshold; 'unknown' when stale or unobservable.

self_stake_metal.description: Operator self-stake in METAL; null when not yet observable.

delegation_fee_percent.description: Delegation fee percentage; null when not yet observable.

public_pages.description: Map of stable page slug to canonical URL. Additive: new pages may appear in this map within v1 without bumping schema_version.

operator_commitments.description: Mirror of /commitments/ as machine-readable booleans / integers.

incident_sla.description: ADDITIVE (2026-06-24). Numeric incident-response targets refining the existing incident_disclosure_sla_hours. These are operator goodwill targets, not contractual SLAs; the validator-host's own integrity always takes precedence over response cadence. Mirror of the /commitments/ #2 'Public incident disclosure' card.

detect_minutes_max.description: Upper bound on time-to-detect from event onset, in minutes. Set by the validator-host cron poll cadence (= 5-minute ticks × 6 = 30 minutes).

acknowledge_hours_business.description: Upper bound on time-to-acknowledge during Japan business hours, in hours. Acknowledgement = an explicit /incidents/ entry plus /api/incidents.json open-flag update.

acknowledge_hours_offhours.description: Upper bound on time-to-acknowledge outside Japan business hours, in hours.

status_update_cadence_hours.description: Maximum elapsed time between status updates while an incident is open, in hours.

resolve_or_escalate_hours.description: Upper bound from acknowledgement to either resolution OR escalation to public disclosure under incident_disclosure_sla_hours, whichever comes first.

live_artifacts.description: Artifacts whose runtime URL is live and served from this site. Each entry MUST carry url + schema_url. Additional URL flavours (signature_url / pubkey_url / formal_schema_url / format_guide_url / operator_guide_url / cross_reference_url) MAY appear when those companions exist. Added 2026-06-22 (additive within schema_version 1) once the Phase α identity manifest and the cycle-history JSONL went live.

schema_url.description: Preview URL — typically an *.example.json showing the runtime shape with sample values. Required.

formal_schema_url.description: Live URL to the formal JSON Schema (draft 2020-12), when published. Optional.

format_guide_url.description: Human-readable manifest format guide / verification recipe.

operator_guide_url.description: Operator-side setup runbook, when one exists.

cross_reference_url.description: URL of a related live artifact whose state this artifact is folded into or relies on (e.g. identity_manifest cross-references cycles-history.json).

in_preparation_artifacts.description: Artifacts whose preview is published but whose runtime URL is not yet live. Each entry MUST carry planned_url + schema_url + format_guide_url. Additional URL flavours (signature / pubkey / formal_schema_url / operator_guide_url) MAY appear when those companions are live. When the artifact's runtime URL goes live, the entry moves to live_artifacts.

schema_url.description: Preview URL — typically an *.example.json showing the runtime shape with sample values. Required.

formal_schema_url.description: Live URL to the formal JSON Schema (draft 2020-12), when published. Optional. Lets a consumer fetch the schema and validate the runtime file with one ajv invocation once the artifact is live.

format_guide_url.description: Human-readable manifest format guide / verification recipe. Required.

operator_guide_url.description: Operator-side setup runbook, when one exists. Optional.

validator_state_observed_at.description: Source validator.json's observedAt timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC), or null when unobservable. NOT constrained to date-time format because null is allowed.

stale_input_warning.description: true iff validator.json's observedAt is older than the freshness threshold. A consumer SHOULD gate on this before reading fields that depend on validator state.
